files.Title: Virtufin.Base.ContractParameters

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Position.Direction

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Position.PositionEvent.Flipped

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Position.PositionSource

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Position.RichPositionEvent.Base
files.Summary: Pass-through wrapper for a raw .

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Position.RichPositionEvent.OpenedWithParty
files.Summary: Position opened with from/to party info (e.g. transfer counterparty).

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Position.RichPositionEvent.UpdatedAttributed
files.Summary: Position updated with attribution.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Position.RichPositionEvent
files.Summary: Enriched position events — same marker as but with attribution, party info, and a pass-through case for the raw event. Use this when consumers need to know who initiated the change (e.g. transfer counterparty info).

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RichRiskEvent.Base
files.Summary: Pass-through for a raw .

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RichRiskEvent.DrawdownWithMetadata
files.Summary: Drawdown with peak/trough/recovery timestamps.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RichRiskEvent.LimitBreachedWithThreshold
files.Summary: Limit breach with both threshold and observed values.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RichRiskEvent.PnLAttributed
files.Summary: P&L attributed to a specific scenario run.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RichRiskEvent
files.Summary: Enriched risk events — same marker as but with attribution metadata and a pass-through case for the raw event.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RiskEvent.DrawdownUpdated
files.Summary: Peak-to-trough drawdown recalculated.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RiskEvent.ExposureBreached
files.Summary: Exposure limit exceeded on a position.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RiskEvent.LimitBreached
files.Summary: Risk limit crossed.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RiskEvent.LimitRestored
files.Summary: Risk limit restored.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RiskEvent.MarginCalled
files.Summary: Forced liquidation triggered (act only).

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RiskEvent.MarginWarned
files.Summary: Margin ratio approaching threshold.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RiskEvent.PnLRealized
files.Summary: Position closed, P&L locked.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RiskEvent.PnLUpdated
files.Summary: Unrealized P&L recalculated on a tick.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Risk.RiskEvent
files.Summary: Sealed ADT of risk events. Eight cases covering P&L, drawdown, limit breaches, exposure breaches, and margin events. Topics use the naming scheme sc.{scenarioId}.risk.{entity}.{event}.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.BuyOrSell
files.Summary: Side of a trade action.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.RichTradeAction.CancelOrder
files.Summary: Enriched cancel order.

files.Summary: Enriched CLOB interest registration.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.RichTradeAction.SellOrder
files.Summary: Enriched sell order.

files.Summary: Enriched peer-to-peer transfer.

files.Summary: Enriched withdrawal of a previously registered interest.

files.Summary: Enriched trade action — wraps a raw with metadata the strategy attaches before execution (strategy attribution, latency budget, routing venue, etc.). Implements the same marker so it flows through the same parameterisation as raw actions.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeAction.BuyOrder
files.Summary: Buy order on a CLOB.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeAction.CancelOrder
files.Summary: Cancel a previously placed order.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeAction.InterestAction
files.Summary: Express interest in a CLOB before commitment.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeAction.SellOrder
files.Summary: Sell order on a CLOB.

files.Summary: Peer-to-peer transfer between two parties (no exchange).

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeAction.WithdrawInterestAction
files.Summary: Revoke a previously registered interest.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeAction
files.Summary:
Sealed algebraic data type of trade actions — the strategy's intent before enrichment. Cases:

  • : limit/market buy on a CLOB.
  • : limit/market sell on a CLOB.
  • : cancel a previously placed order.
  • : peer-to-peer transfer between two parties (no exchange).
  • : express interest in a CLOB before commitment — no risk, no book impact.
  • : revoke a previously registered interest.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.ExecutionCleared
files.Summary: Obligations confirmed (collapses into fill on Binance CEX).

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.ExecutionSettled
files.Summary: Assets transferred, books closed.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.FillReceived
files.Summary: Partial or full fill received from exchange.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.InterestExpired
files.Summary: Interest window expired without matching.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.InterestMatched
files.Summary: Interest matched against a fill (attribution event for analytics).

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.InterestRegistered
files.Summary: Interest registered with the venue (no book impact).

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.InterestRevoked
files.Summary: Interest explicitly revoked by the strategy.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.OrderCancelled
files.Summary: Cancel confirmed by exchange.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.OrderExpired
files.Summary: GTC/GTD order lapsed.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.OrderPlaced
files.Summary: Order submitted to exchange.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.TransferCompleted
files.Summary: Peer-to-peer transfer completed.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.TransferFailed
files.Summary: Peer-to-peer transfer rejected or failed.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent.TransferInitiated
files.Summary: Peer-to-peer transfer initiated.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.TradeEvent
files.Summary: Sealed algebraic data type of trade events parameterised by . Each case carries the originating action for correlation. Topics use the naming scheme sc.{scenarioId}.trade.{entity}.{event}.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Events.Trade.Venue
files.Summary: Trading venue identifier.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Execution.DeterministicExecutorBase<TState, TAction, TEvent>
files.Summary: Pure deterministic executor base: no randomness, no IO, no hidden state. Subclasses define the case-by-case fill logic (what event to emit for each TAction variant) and the initial state.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Execution.DeterministicState
files.Summary: State for the DeterministicExecutor — empty, since deterministic execution has no hidden state.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Execution.LiveExecutorBase<TState, TAction, TEvent>
files.Summary: Live executor base for routing actions to a real exchange. Subclasses define the exchange-routing strategy in . No assumptions about routing, fallback, or state evolution — all in the subclass.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Execution.ObserveOnlyExecutor<TState, TAction, TEvent>
files.Summary: Decorator executor that wraps any other and records what would have happened without sending orders to the exchange. Used in SHADOW_* scenarios.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Execution.SlippageExecutorBase<TState, TAction, TEvent>
files.Summary: Executor base that models bid-ask slippage. Subclasses define the slippage distribution (no distribution assumed by the base) and how the slippage value is applied to the case-by-case fill logic.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Execution.StochasticState
files.Summary: State for stochastic executors — a seeded PRNG. Deterministic given the seed, reproducible across runs. Mutable: the PRNG seed evolves as the executor steps.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Message
files.Summary: Concrete : a plus the that signed it.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Messaging.Topics
files.Summary: Static factory methods for Dapr-compatible topic strings following the domain spec's naming scheme.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Position
files.Summary: A holding: a in some .

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.PositionSize
files.Summary: A position size expressed as a rational Quote × Multiplier / Divisor so positions in different units (e.g. lots vs. shares) can be combined without losing precision.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.PositionTransferContract
files.Summary: A contract that transfers a from one to another at a fixed (its maturity).

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.PositionTransferContractMessageGenerator
files.Summary: Emits a single wrapped in a at the contract's maturity. Before or after the maturity nothing is emitted.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Scenario
files.Summary: Concrete : a paired with a . Financial-contract snapshot used by Virtufin.Core's simulation model.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.ScenarioHistory
files.Summary: Concrete backed by an in-memory list of scenarios. New scenarios are emitted through a hot with no replay buffer — late subscribers see only future emissions.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Scenarios.InMemoryScenarioRegistry
files.Summary: In-memory implementation of . Suitable for tests, CI, and single-process scenarios.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Scenarios.ScenarioConfiguration
files.Summary: Concrete record.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Scenarios.StandardScenarios
files.Summary: Standard scenario configurations (LIVE, PAPER_LIVE, BACKTEST, SHADOW) matching the canonical combinations in the domain spec.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Signatory
files.Summary: Identifier for a party to a contract or transaction. Backed by a Guid.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.State
files.Summary: Concrete : a set of transactions observed at a single time-point.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Stock
files.Summary: A tradeable equity instrument identified by an opaque string (typically an exchange ticker or an ISIN).

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.TimeStamp
files.Summary: Calendar-date-backed . Time-of-day is intentionally discarded; financial contracts settle on calendar dates.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Transaction.AtomicTransactions
files.Summary: An atomic group of transactions.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Transaction.CancelContract
files.Summary: Cancel an existing contract.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Transaction.CreateContract
files.Summary: Create a new contract.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Transaction.Transfer
files.Summary: Transfer a position between two parties, authorised by a contract.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.Transaction
files.Summary:
Concrete for the financial contract model. Three cases are supported:

  • : create a new contract with the given parameters.
  • : terminate the named contract.
  • : an atomic group of transactions; not tied to a single contract.

files.Title: Virtufin.Base.UtiValidator
files.Summary: Validates ISDA Universal Transaction Identifier (UTI) payloads.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Behaviour.IAlgebra<TEvent, TState>
files.Summary: An F-algebra over an event log. Given a current state and an event, produce the next state. Combined with the initial state and an event log, the algebra defines a derived signal via the fold (or scan for running computation).

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Behaviour.IProcess<TState, TInput, TOutput>
files.Summary: Coalgebra shape for a stateful process: given the current state and an input observation, produce the next state and an output. Used to model decide (strategy) and execute (execution engine) where the process carries hidden state that must be exposed explicitly.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Behaviour.ISignal<T>
files.Summary: A continuously derivable value computed from an event log. Signals are never transported on Dapr topics; consumers reconstruct them on demand by folding the log.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Clock.IClock<T>
files.Summary: A clock is a stream of time values emitted as events. Each emission is a T (typically DateTimeOffset) representing a point in time. Subscribers receive emissions via ; callers should NOT poll the clock for a "current value".

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IAsset
files.Summary: A tradeable asset. In the financial-model sense an asset has no counterparty risk (it is issued, not bilaterally agreed). Used as the underlying of Position and the building block of contracts.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IContract
files.Summary: A financial contract: an agreement that, given a sequence of messages arriving at particular time-points, produces a sequence of valid transactions. Implementations decide which messages they accept via .

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IContractBuilder
files.Summary: Builds a concrete instance from . The builder is consumed once; use an for repeated construction.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IContractFactory
files.Summary: Builds a concrete instance from . Distinct from : factories are stateless and reusable, builders are single-shot.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IContractParameters
files.Summary: Marker for any opaque, equality-comparable bundle of inputs required to build a contract. The concrete payload is implementation-specific; in the canonical case it wraps a Virtufin.Data.Variant so the same data can be serialised through FlatBuffers or MessagePack.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IContractRegistry
files.Summary: Resolves instances by . Distinct from in Virtufin.Core, which is the EAV value/attribute registry and unrelated to the financial contract registry.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IMessage
files.Summary: A signed wrapper around a : a transaction plus the that authorised it. Contracts use messages to filter the work they perform on a given time-point via .

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IMessageGenerator
files.Summary: Generates the set of s a contract would emit at a given timePoint given the prior scenarioHistory. Used to drive simulation forward.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IScenario
files.Summary: A snapshot of the system at a single time-point: the time itself plus the of transactions observed.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IScenarioHistory
files.Summary: An append-only sequence of snapshots. Provides pull-based lookup () and a push-based observable () for late subscribers — the latter is a hot Subject<IScenario> with no replay buffer.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IState
files.Summary: The set of transactions that have been observed at a single time-point. A scenario's carries one of these.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.ITransaction
files.Summary: A unit of business activity: a creation, cancellation, transfer, or any other operation that may be applied to a contract. Transactions carry an optional pointer to the contract they affect; for composite transactions (e.g. an atomic set of operations) the pointer is null.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.ITransactionExecutor
files.Summary: Applies a Transaction to the system, returning a new reflecting the change.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Contracts.IWithMaturity
files.Summary: A contract that has a definite maturity (the time-point at which it settles). Used by MaturitySelectorPredicate to filter messages.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.EntityAttributeValueTypeSpecifier<V>
files.Summary: Helper class to implement where the type membership predicate is defines a set, where all elements have the same type of the value

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Events.ClockType
files.Summary: Clock interpretation for .

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Events.CloudEvent
files.Summary: Minimal CloudEvents v1.0 representation. Used as the wire format for Dapr pub/sub topics. Conforms to https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/v1.0.2/spec.md.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Events.IEvent
files.Summary: Marker for any value that participates in the Virtufin event flow. Events are immutable facts; they are appended to logs, transported on Dapr topics, and folded into state by algebræ. Implementations should be records so they have value equality.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Events.IEventEnvelope
files.Summary: The transport envelope carried alongside every event. Combines the routing context (, triplet), the clock interpretation (, ), audit/processing metadata (, , ), and a human-readable .

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Events.Lane
files.Summary: Market component lane.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Events.Market.IMarketEvent
files.Summary: Marker for any raw market observation — exogenous price or order-book state from the data feed. Candles, VWAP, and other derived signals are NOT s — see RichMarketEvent for those.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Events.Position.IPositionEvent
files.Summary: Marker for any event that changes a holding. Position events flow through the unified sc.{scenarioId}.position.* topic family and include holdings lifecycle changes only (open/update/close/flip). Exposure breaches are reported separately under Risk.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Events.Risk.IRiskEvent
files.Summary: Marker for any risk-related event. Risk events are attributed to the scenario as a whole — they depend on all three components (market, portfolio, strategy) jointly. Topics use the naming scheme sc.{scenarioId}.risk.{entity}.{event}.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Events.Symbol
files.Summary: Identifier for a tradeable instrument on a venue. Implements so any existing Virtufin.Base.AssetIdentifier (currency, stock, etc.) can also be used as a trade symbol.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Events.Trade.ITradeAction
files.Summary: Marker for any action that flows through the trading loop. A trade action is the strategy's intent: buy, sell, cancel, transfer between parties, or express interest in a CLOB before commitment. Implementations form a sealed ADT (TradeAction) and an enriched variant (RichTradeAction).

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Events.Trade.ITradeEvent<A>
files.Summary: Trade event parameterised by the action type that produced it. Used by IExecutor<S, A, E> with the constraint E : ITradeEvent<A> to enforce that an executor producing events for A can only emit events in the TradeEvent<A> hierarchy.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Execution.IExecutionState
files.Summary: Marker for any type that carries the hidden state of an execution engine (PRNG seed, API key material, account balance, etc.).

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Execution.IExecutor<TState, TAction, TEvent>
files.Summary: Signature of an execution engine: given the current TState and a TAction, produce the next state and an TEvent describing the outcome. The event type is constrained to be parameterised by the action type so the executor statically cannot emit events for the wrong action universe.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.IEntityAttributeValueTypeSpecifier
files.Summary: As C# doesn't support dependent types, we cannot define a class which is given by generic constraints to the values of the entities, attributes and values in terms of some (value) depedent type at compile time. We have to check the test if a entity/attribute/value triplet belongs to a particular class to runtime via a type membbrship predicate, instead

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Identifiers.IAssetIdentifier
files.Summary: Marker for any value that identifies an asset (currency, security, or other tradeable instrument). Implementations must be equality-comparable so positions and contracts can be matched by their underlying asset.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Identifiers.IContractIdentifier
files.Summary: Marker for any value that uniquely identifies a contract (e.g. a UUID, an ISDA UTI, or an opaque string). Implementations must be equality-comparable so transactions and contracts can be matched by identifier.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Identifiers.ISignatory
files.Summary: Marker for any value that identifies a party to a contract or transaction. Implementations must be equality-comparable so contracts and message selectors can match by sender.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Identifiers.ITimeStamp
files.Summary: Marker for any value that represents a point in time. Implementations must be totally orderable and equality-comparable so they can drive time-based selection (, , etc.).

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Messaging.EventDelivery
files.Summary: An envelope/payload pair delivered from a topic subscription.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Messaging.IEventPublisher
files.Summary: Publishes a single event to a Dapr-compatible topic. Implementations may wrap DaprClient.PublishEventAsync, an in-memory bus for tests, or any other transport.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Messaging.IEventSubscriber
files.Summary: Subscribes to a topic and surfaces incoming events as an observable stream of envelope/payload pairs.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Messaging.Topic
files.Summary: Dapr-compatible topic identifier. Topics are strings that match the documented naming scheme; subscribers use to consume events on a topic, publishers use to publish.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Position.BuyOrSell
files.Summary: Side of a trade.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Position.DecimalQuantity<U>
files.Summary: A paired with an . Formats as "{Amount} {Unit}".

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Position.IAmount<TValue>
files.Summary: A typed monetary or physical quantity. TValue is the underlying representation (e.g. a tuple of whole and fractional parts for fixed-point DecimalAmount).

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Position.IAsCardinal<TCardinal>
files.Summary: Bridges between an and a single canonical integer representation. Used to implement arithmetic on amounts whose parts live in different fields (whole vs. fractional).

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Position.IOrderBook
files.Summary: An append-only collection of orders / transactions representing the live book at a venue. The transaction type is the generic from Virtufin.Core.Contracts so orders of any concrete kind can be accommodated.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Position.IQuantity<TAmount, TUnit>
files.Summary: An tagged with an .

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Position.IUnit
files.Summary: Marker for any value that represents a unit of measure (currency, share, barrel, etc.). Implementations must be equality-comparable and printable.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Position.LimitOrMarketOrder
files.Summary: Order type discriminator.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Position.SimpleOrder<U>
files.Summary: A simple order: buy or sell side, limit or market execution type, and a quantity.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Predicates.AllMessageSelectorPredicate
files.Summary: AND-composition of s: matches a message iff every contained predicate accepts it. With an empty predicate list, the predicate accepts every message (vacuous truth).

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Predicates.ContractSelectorPredicate
files.Summary: Default selector that matches a message iff its transaction targets contract.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Predicates.IMessageSelectorPredicate
files.Summary: A composable filter that decides whether a given should be considered for a given at a given time and scenario history.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Predicates.IVerificationMessageFilter
files.Summary: Verification-side message filter. Given the transactions attached to a contract and the prior scenario history, return the subset deemed applicable for downstream execution.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Predicates.IVerificationMessageFilterCombinator
files.Summary: Combinator that produces a composite from a sequence of sub-filters. Implementations decide how the sub-filters compose (typically AND, but UNION or sequenced composition are valid).

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Predicates.MaturitySelectorPredicate
files.Summary: Selector that matches a message iff timePoint equals the contract's maturity. Requires the contract to implement ; otherwise the predicate rejects every message.

files.Title: Virtufin.Core.Predicates.SenderSelectorPredicate
